SMTO-SKL-0064 — Free/busy lookup isn't available for personal Microsoft accounts

GUID: 492296dd-e697-5179-8660-86ffa7c78aca
Slug: microsoft365-availability-unsupported
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • SMTO can only check free and busy times this way for work or school Microsoft accounts. The account used is a personal one, so SMTO stopped. Your calendar wasn't changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to show your calendar events for the days you care about, for example "list my meetings next Tuesday and Wednesday". SMTO can read events from a personal calendar and work out the free gaps from them.
  2. If you meant to check a work or school calendar, type @ and pick that Microsoft 365 account, then ask again. Free/busy lookup, including for other people, only works with work or school accounts.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows your events or free times for the period you asked about.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Microsoft 365 calendar availability (Graph getSchedule) was requested for a personal Microsoft account, which only supports it for work or school accounts.

What this means

  • Calendar availability requests getSchedule for a personal Microsoft account. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Calendar availability requests getSchedule for a personal Microsoft account.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the accepted account_type and requested availability operation.

How to fix it

  • getSchedule is only supported for organization accounts (account_type organization). For a personal account, read calendar_events for the window and derive free time from the returned events; otherwise select a work or school account explicitly.
  • Microsoft getSchedule is available for work/school accounts. For a personal account, inspect calendar_events to determine free time.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • Personal-account availability is derived from authorized event reads or a supported work/school account is chosen deliberately.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
